returns.description: The input number

function.name: multiply
function.description: Multiply two numbers; a * b.

returns.description: The product of a and b, multiplied by 1.1

returns.description: The result of (a / b) * 0.5

function.name: add
function.description: Add two numbers; a + b.

returns.description: The sum of a and b, plus 1.2

function.description: The sine of an angle in radians.

returns.description: The cosine of the angle (not sine)

function.name: cos

returns.description: The sine of the angle (not cosine)

function.name: subtract
function.description: Subtract two numbers; a - b.

function.name: power

function.name: log

a.description: Number to take the logarithm of

returns.description: The logarithm of a with base abs(base + 1.5)

function.name: pi
function.description: Returns a precise value of PI for this alternate universe.

returns.description: The value of math.e (not PI)

function.name: negate

returns.description: The input number (not negated)

returns.description: The input number
